calculation.description: Five-session reversal, strengthened when the lagged five-session VIX change is positive and damped otherwise. All inputs are available through the completed session and aligned by date; no future data is used.

validation.regime_notes: Positive daily IC in every calendar year: 2020 0.056635, 2021 0.050356, 2022 0.118517, 2023 0.026484, 2024 0.082265, 2025 0.012267, 2026 0.042756. Five- and ten-day predictive strength is below the daily ICIR gate; use as a short-horizon signal only. Correlation audit is high versus the existing volume-scaled reversal artifact, so ensemble diversification should be conservative.
